steps.content: Dense black sand assaults the city. The overhead barrier is on the verge of collapse. Cracks are spreading in the trembling rock structures. Sandy wind and Mania seep through these rifts into Furor, stinging exposed skin with every gust.
Hella races through the ruined city, searching for any remaining residents.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Taric! Zade! Old Rosse! Granny Nysa!
The streets are empty. They must have gone to the shelter, which has to be...
[Background: Cave Chamber]

The cave entrance is barricaded with layers of wooden planks and rubble. Furorians struggle to fend off vicious beasts trying to force their way through the rifts. Their defenses are fragile, but they continue to fight with grim determination.

Taric pulls wooden planks from a shelf, desperately reinforcing the cave's defenses. The outer barricades are being stripped away by the relentless sand beasts, forcing him to reapply layer after layer futilely.
The next moment, a sharp whoosh cuts through the air, and light suddenly streams through a rift that was completely blocked by sand beasts just now.

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: ...Hella?!

Hella is pulled into the chamber. The cave is in complete chaos, filled with painful moans and sobs. The wounded lie in the deepest part of the room, while every Furorian still able to stand forms a protective line in front of them, weapons in hand.

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: Where did you run off to? We still need to go and rescue the others. You should stay here with Granny and the rest. It's safer here...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No! Wrong! You got it all wrong!
Hella interrupts Taric, panting heavily.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The Apostle outside is growing stronger! It'll break through the barrier any minute now... Forget about the lab! We need to escape and get the hell out of here!

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: What are you talking about? With Hypatia on our side, there's no way they could so easily...
The defenses at the entrance are attacked again. Hella swings her pipe to repel sand beasts nearly bursting into the room, shouting at the top of her lungs.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Aurum Secretum can't protect Furor! It won't save anyone and can't truly block Mania... Don't you get it yet? The Campbells left you all here to die for them!
As Hella finishes speaking, she realizes the room has fallen completely silent.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Old Rosse? Taric? Hey... Just, say something?
Rosse and Taric exchange a knowing glance, then sigh with resignation.

steps.speaker: Rosse
steps.content: Actually, we've known all of that for some time now.

steps.speaker: Rosse
steps.content: Some strange horned woman dressed like a Fraser official told us in the marketplace today.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...What?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: If you all knew this already, then why are you still here...?
Hella looks around at everyone in bewilderment, seeing the same wry, knowing smile on all of their faces.

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: Hella, we have nowhere else to go... Our homes were all destroyed by disasters long ago.

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: You guys have got Hypercubes in DisCity. You don't have to worry about waking up to find your house buried in sand, or whether you'll survive until morning. Here, even if you do survive, you'd have to abandon your homeland and hide in shelters, living day by day...

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: Hypatia also offered to take us away, but where else could we go?
Hella is rendered speechless. As she scans the room, she sees children, the elderly, people who are sick, injured, or disabled... She can't even find a single person who she can call healthy.
Everyone here bears countless wounds and endless exhaustion. These are the marks that disasters and long-term suffering have carved into their bodies.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No... it shouldn't be like this...
Her eyes feel stung as her vision blurs.
She's seen it all. The powerless struggle desperately just to survive, only to end up merely existing rather than living.
The kind souls who suffer constantly and still yearn that one day hope might arrive.
And the cunning ones who live on the edges, sending off their fallen companions with songs of farewell.
The shadows from her memories begin to merge with the people before her. All of them so fragile, yet so resolute.

There are no more materials left in the chamber to reinforce the barricades. The growls outside the cave grow louder. The defensive line is about to collapse. The wooden boards are shaking, but a pair of firm hands steady them.
One by one, the Furorians move past Hella to the front, filling in the gaps in the defense line using their own bodies.

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: Hypatia is smarter than all of us. She has knowledge and influence, and is the genius of the Campbell family. She can accomplish things that none of us can do.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But if you stay... you'll all die...

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: If sacrificing one person can save a hundred, if leaving us behind will help Hypatia escape faster and further so she can save many more people in the future...

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: Then we'll stay willingly, without regret.
More people brush past Hella, walking forward without hesitation toward their mission.
Strings of rosaries get taken off and placed in Hella's palms. Children should always be protected. They're leaving their blessings to Hella.

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: Perhaps someday, she'll develop the perfect Aurum Secretum. It'll change the whole WhiteSands, helping our compatriots who were separated from us during the disasters, so...

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: It's okay if our Furor disappears. There will be more Furors in the future. They will live on in our place.
Another Growl. The chamber shakes as the barricade at the entrance collapses. A sharp claw reaches in and hooks onto Taric's clothes, nearly dragging him out of the cave, but...
[Background - City Center - Night] A tremendous boom echoes through the air. The sand beast at the cave entrance lets out a violent shriek of pain.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Is that...
A slender figure stands on the open ground outside the cave.
Her usually immaculate cloak is stained with dust. She's wounded, having dealt with countless invaders on her way here. Fallen corpses litter the ground outside the cave.
Unnatural protrusions can be seen in her hand. Bizarrely shaped metal penetrates her wrist, extending from the wound, climbing upward, deeply embedded in her flesh.
The two stand in silence. After a long while, Hella finally begins slowly.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You knew they wouldn't leave.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Yes.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You knew that they believed in your Aurum Secretum so much they were willing to die for it. You knew everything all along!

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...I'm sorry.
Hella's vision blurs. She roughly rubs her eyes, forcing back the tears threatening to fall.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: They're all idiots... I mean, staying alive is what matters most. Why doesn't anyone get that? The Apostle is coming. We're running out of time...
A hand reaches out, gently pulling Hella's hand away from her face.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: No, we still have a chance.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: The Furorians won't follow me, but I'm sure you can find a way to make them go with you. Trick them, coax them, or even threaten them... no offense, but if you wanted to, you could do all these things, couldn't you?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I could indeed... No, that's not the point!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But what happens after we get out? The Aurum Secretum won't protect them. With a Sinner around, the Apostle will still catch up to us...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I will destroy it.
Hypatia's expression is resolute. She means every word.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No way! That's an Apostle of Ashes we're talking about. Even injured, it's not something you can take down alone!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: And... and the Campbells value you so much, they won't just let you walk away! And what about your research? Without you, the Aurum Secretum will...
Hypatia shakes her head. She raises her arm, revealing shards of Aurum Secretum embedded in her flesh, as if erupting from beneath her skin.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: The small doll you threw at me contained a piece of highly refined Aurum Secretum. It was part of my Aurum Secretum barrier research. Although Synex consumed all the other parts, fortunately, this piece remains.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Using Sinner power to control it is something only I, its inventor, can accomplish.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But still...
The girl's fingertips gently press against her chest, touching the cold insignia pinned above her heart.
Moonlight bathes the city, illuminating her profile. Her eyes are downcast, but her voice remains determined.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Being a Campbell means being exceptional, more formidable than ordinary people. Protected by Fraser City, drawing wisdom from our ancestors' knowledge, we must also bear the responsibility of returning this wisdom to our people.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Having received everyone's respect, I must live up to their trust. I must protect Furor and everyone. This time I won't run away. These should have been my promises all along, and they are my responsibility.
She pauses, her voice low and hoarse.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Not to mention that...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: The Campbells have already failed them once. I cannot break my promise a second time.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You're an idiot too.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You're gonna face the Apostle alone? With what? If anyone could take that thing down solo, it wouldn't still be here today! You pigheaded idiot! You arrogant snob! You...
Running out of insults, Hella looks dejected suddenly.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: One life versus a hundred... this should never be a choice we have to make...
Cold fingers brush against the back of Hella's hand. Hypatia gently takes hold of it, just as she did when they first met.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Help me, Hella. <color=#fb9259>He</color> told me I could depend on you.
steps.female_content: Help me, Hella. <color=#fb9259>She</color> told me I could depend on you.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Go now. I must make my preparations.
A whistle sounds from above. Hella looks up to see Horo with the Legion gathered behind her.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: ...We're out of time. Let's follow her plan for now.
Hella wants to say more, but Hypatia gently pushes her toward the Legion.
They part ways. As Hella walks toward Horo, she turns to look back, seeing only a thin, frail figure standing alone in the distance.
She waves goodbye until rocks obscure her silhouette and she vanishes from sight.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Goodbye, Hella.
